arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Kneedler argued FERC reasonably denied the contract modification request.
Mr. Garre stated FERC believed it retained some interpretive authority.
Mr. Wright emphasized FERC understood itself to lack discretion here.
